description: This file contains the implementation of an Informix database driver and related classes for the ADOdb PHP database abstraction library. It defines the ADODB_informix72 class, which manages database connection, querying, and metadata operations specific to Informix databases, as well as a corresponding recordset class for fetching query results.

classes.name: ADODB_informix72
classes.description: Database driver class for Informix, managing connection, SQL execution, and metadata retrieval specific to Informix databases.

classes.name: ADORecordset_informix72
classes.description: Recordset class for fetching query results from an Informix database, supporting operations like seeking, moving, and fetching fields.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the Informix database using provided hostname, username, password, and database name.

methods.name: _pconnect
methods.description: Establishes a persistent connection to the Informix database.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Executes a SQL query and stores the result resource.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves server version and description information.

methods.name: _insertID
methods.description: Retrieves the last inserted ID from the current transaction.

methods.name: _affectedrows
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last query.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about columns of a specified table.
